completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10914_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 4 条，缺 3）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en: Mr. Hans-Peter Smit is hereby granted Philippine citizenship with all the rights, privileges and prerogatives, as well as the duties and obligations appurtenant thereto under the Constitution and the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.

After the taking by Mr. Hans-Peter Smit of his Oath of Allegiance before an officer duly authorized for this purpose, and the registration of the same with the Bureau of Immigration, Mr. Hans-Peter Smit shall enter upon the full enjoyment of his Philippine citizenship.
Section 3 . Upon registration of the Oath of Allegiance, the Bureau of Immigration shall forthwith issue Mr. Hans-Peter Smit’s Certificate of Naturalization.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
